newsitem.title: ITALY: RAS premiums up seven pct in five months.
newsitem.headline: RAS premiums up seven pct in five months.

text.p: Italian insurance group RAS said on Wednesday that premium income in the first five months of 1997 rose more than seven percent, with general premiums up five percent and life premiums rising 12 percent.
The group's chairman Angelo Marchio was giving the company's annual shareholders meeting an update of trading in the January-May period of 1997.

The group which is controlled by German insurance giant Allianz, said three new board members were joining the RAS board. These three were Pirelli chairman Marco Tronchetti Provera, Allianz board member Detlev Brenkamp and university professor Alberto Santamaria. These will replace Roberto Cavazzi, Leopoldo Pirelli and Renato Riverso.
